title: How to Set Up a Python Project for Agentic Coding
description: Learn how to set up a Python project for agentic coding, with the tests, types, and hooks that give AI coding agents fast feedback.
summary: Modern AI agents can write functions, refactor modules, generate tests, and implement entire features from a natural language prompt. But their output is only as reliable as the project they’re working in.
takeaways: A Python project for agentic coding answers the questions an agent would otherwise guess at: how your project is organized and which tools to run.

You’ll receive a score upon completion to help you track your learning progress: Interactive Quiz How to Set Up a Python Project for Agentic Coding Check how well you can set up a Python project for agentic coding, with the tests, type checks, linting, and hooks that give AI agents fast feedback.
In this tutorial, you’ll build a Python project optimized for agentic coding from an empty directory.
